consequence.statement: ExternalSecret (external-secrets.io/v1beta1) resources that set spec.target.template.engineVersion to "v1" are rejected by the API server, so creating or updating them fails.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, change spec.target.template.engineVersion on v1beta1 ExternalSecrets away from "v1" to a value the new schema permits (or drop the override); otherwise creating or updating those resources fails.

assertion.statement: The external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ExternalSecret schema tightened validation on spec.target.template.engineVersion: the previously allowed value \"v1\" was removed from the enum, so the API server rejects resources using it.

checks.detail: crd-field validation-tightened is not render-verifiable (runtime-only or no rendered shape)
